name: Table 1-12: Habitability
_doc: Skip if Planet has no atmosphere OR atmosphere is not Tainted/Pure. Hot/Cold Worlds apply -2. Burning/Ice Worlds apply -7 and cap result at 3.

rows.name: Inhospitable
rows.description: No life or water on this Planet.

rows.name: Trapped Water
rows.description: Water exists but requires processing — frozen, vaporised, deep underground, or contaminated.

rows.name: Liquid Water
rows.description: Liquid water accessible on the surface, but no native life has arisen.

rows.name: Limited Ecosystem
rows.description: Native life of limited variety — basic proto-biology or restricted spread.

rows.name: Verdant
rows.description: Thriving native ecosystem with diverse life forms.
